supportMessage.Name: Support the Developer
supportMessage.Hint: Click to select and copy the link

SniperOffset.Name: Offset
SniperOffset.Hint: How far it can move from center of token

DefaultIcon.Name: Default Target Icon
DefaultIcon.Hint: Icon used when player custom icons are disabled or not set

PlayerIcons.Name: Custom Player Icon
PlayerIcons.Hint: If empty, the default target icon will be used for this player

EnablePlayerIcons.Name: Enable Custom Player Icons
EnablePlayerIcons.Hint: When disabled, all players will see the default target icon

RotationSpeed.Name: Rotation Speed
RotationSpeed.Hint: How fast the icon rotates (negative values reverse direction)

ScaleAnimationSpeed.Name: Pulsing Speed
ScaleAnimationSpeed.Hint: How fast the icon pulses (scale animation)

RotateOnMove.Name: Disable rotation
RotateOnMove.Hint: When enabled, the icon rotates only when the token has speed greater than 0

IconScale.Name: Icon Scale
IconScale.Hint: Adjust the size of the targeting icon relative to the token

IconColor.Name: Icon Color
IconColor.Hint: Apply a color tint to the targeting icon (best results with white icons)

UsePlayerColor.Name: Use Player Colors
UsePlayerColor.Hint: Tint the icon with each player's assigned color

clearAllTargets.Name: Clear All Targets
clearAllTargets.Hint: Press Alt+C to clear all currently targeted tokens

ManageIcons.Title: Player Targeting Icons
ManageIcons.Description: Set custom targeting icons for each player
ManageIcons.Note: Note: Players will see their own icon on tokens they target. The GM sees all player icons.
